learningObjective: Understand IREE's overall architecture: an MLIR-based compiler that produces a bytecode module executed by IREE's runtime.
stem: Which statement about IREE's architecture is correct?

options.text: IREE is a pure Python interpreter for StableHLO IR; it does not perform ahead-of-time compilation and has no separate runtime binary.
IREE targets only mobile/edge deployment; it has no support for server-class GPUs like NVIDIA A100/H100 and cannot use MLIR dialects beyond `tosa`.
IREE is a runtime wrapper around cuBLAS/cuDNN; the 'compilation' step consists of choosing which library kernel to invoke for each op, with no MLIR pipeline in between.

IREE is an MLIR-based compiler that lowers input IR (StableHLO / linalg / tosa) through target-specific pipelines and produces a serialized VM module (`.vmfb`) plus device-specific artifacts; the IREE runtime loads the module and dispatches host and device work through a HAL abstraction supporting CPU / Vulkan / CUDA / Metal / ROCm backends.

explanation: IREE is an MLIR-based ahead-of-time compiler and runtime designed for portable ML deployment. Input dialects include StableHLO, linalg, and tosa; the compiler runs target-specific lowering pipelines (via the MLIR PassManager) and emits a VM bytecode module plus device-specific artifacts (SPIR-V, PTX, etc.). The runtime uses a Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) to dispatch to backends: CPU (LLVM), Vulkan, CUDA, Metal, ROCm, and more. Both edge and server GPUs are targets.

optionExplanations.A: Wrong: IREE is not a Python interpreter.
optionExplanations.B: Wrong: IREE targets both edge and server GPUs.
optionExplanations.C: Wrong: IREE has a full MLIR lowering pipeline; it is not a library wrapper.
optionExplanations.D: Correct: MLIR-based AOT compiler + VM bytecode + HAL runtime.

assumptions: IREE 2024+ architecture as documented on iree.dev.
nonImplications: Does not imply IREE outperforms hand-tuned vendor libraries on every workload.
Does not imply the runtime is a single binary; it is a library integrated by the host application.

distractorRationales.B: Wrong claim that IREE is edge-only.
distractorRationales.C: Underestimates the MLIR pipeline in IREE.
